trailhead.label: The S-charl PostAuto stop, the board’s start

cautions: Cows graze around Alp Sesvenna in summer: lead short and go round the herd.
At 1,800–2,100 m the weather turns fast: bring a layer for you and your dog.
The alp road is used by farm vehicles and bikes: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Cows graze around Alp Sesvenna in summer: D'estate le mucche pascolano attorno all'Alp Sesvenna: guinzaglio corto e aggira la mandria.
textIt.At 1,800–2,100 m the weather turns fast:: A 1.800–2.100 m il tempo cambia in fretta: porta uno strato in più per te e per il cane.
textIt.The alp road is used by farm vehicles an: La strada d'alpe è percorsa da mezzi agricoli e biciclette: tieni il cane vicino.
